snippet.title: Final Stepasy - Voxel Maps - We did it!
snippet.description:
Today were posting an update about Voxel maps We went from 2D to completely 3D maps!

Don't forget to Like , Comment, Share  and Subscribe!
If you like my videos check out my Final Stepasy Playlist!

Join our discord!
https://discord.gg/swtWWrGNa5
Visit our Website!
http://www.finalstepasy.com
Visit my Itch page!
https://himizzy.itch.io/

Final Stepasy is a Turn-Based FF-Like MMORPG inspired by the classic Final Fantasy era—only with online party play, real-time world navigation, and tactical combat at its core. Final Stepasy lets you team up, fight monsters, and clear dungeons in a persistent pixel-art world.

Every battle is fully synced: leaders call the shots, followers play their turns, and your actions matter. Level up, collect loot, and work together—or wipe together.

If you’re looking for an old-school, no-BS RPG with modern multiplayer features, you’ve found it.
